cards.front: Recall a key point about Kinetics and Equilibria
cards.back: Rate = Delta[conc]/Deltat; collision theory: effective collisions need E >= Ea and correct orientation

cards.front: Recall a key point about Kinetics and Equilibria
cards.back: Maxwell-Boltzmann: at higher T, more molecules exceed Ea -> exponentially more effective collisions

cards.front: Recall a key point about Kinetics and Equilibria
cards.back: Rate law: rate = k[A]ᵐ[B]ⁿ; m,n = order (not necessarily stoichiometric); overall order = m+n

cards.front: Recall a key point about Kinetics and Equilibria
cards.back: 1st order: rate = k[A]; t½ = ln2/k (constant); ln[A] = -kt + ln[A]₀

cards.front: Recall a key point about Kinetics and Equilibria
cards.back: Arrhenius: ln k = -Ea/RT + ln A; plot ln k vs 1/T gives slope -Ea/R

cards.front: Recall a key point about Kinetics and Equilibria
cards.back: Le Chatelier: system shifts to oppose change. Conc: shift to consume added; Pressure: shift to fewer gas moles; Temp: exo shifts left on heating

cards.front: Recall a key point about Kinetics and Equilibria
cards.back: Kc = [products]/[reactants] (equilibrium conc, powers = coeffs); Kp uses partial pressures

cards.front: Recall a key point about Kinetics and Equilibria
cards.back: Kp = Kc(RT)^Deltan where Deltan = moles gas products - moles gas reactants

cards.front: Recall a key point about Kinetics and Equilibria
cards.back: Catalyst: lowers Ea, increases rate equally both directions; NO effect on K or equilibrium position
